Triage: lands in `domain:ui` (design-mode menu save) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Bug · follow-ups of #36363 / PR #36437 graded below a blocker: id-less twin entries, a 404 stored read, moves into a contributed group, and no version pin on save. UX has no p3 → p2 (was p3) · size S.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Two refinements from PR #36437's delta review on head d1522bfb.
- N10: the editor's "own end" of a group depends on the stored read made at mount. While that read is pending or has failed, no entry is marked contributed, so an entry added at a group's end is drawn after the contributed run but stored before it. Nothing wrong is written.
- N9 is wider than first written. In a group that another package contributes, 「添加菜单项」 and 「移到分组」 draw the entry first in that group, but the save puts it at the end of the stored top level.
